title: Properness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$ with $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ along $S_i\to S_0$ and $f:X\to Y$ its base change along $S\to S_0$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $f$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $f_0$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], then there is $i\ge0$ such that $f_i$ is proper.

proof.text: Represent a, b and f₀ as objects and a morphism in Over Sᵢ₀. The Over.pullback morphism is definitionally the given pullback.map. Properness gives separatedness at the limit, so Scheme.exists_isSeparated_overPullbackMap gives i₁ ≥ i₀ with f₁ separated.

The affine transition to i₁ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Hence the pulled-back source is quasi-compact and target qcqs. Local finite type is preserved by MorphismProperty.overPullbackMap. A morphism from a quasi-compact source to a quasi-separated target is quasi-compact. Apply exists_chow_finite_type to f₁ to obtain n, T₁, π₁, j₁ and their commutative triangle.

Apply exists_closed_chow_stage to this fixed Chow diagram and the separated stage. It gives i ≥ i₁, a surjection π to Xᵢ, a closed immersion j into projective space over Yᵢ, their triangle, and separatedness of fᵢ.

The closed immersion j is proper, as is the projective projection (ProjectiveSpace.instIsProper). Their composite, equal to π followed by fᵢ, is proper. UniversallyClosed.of_comp_surjective makes fᵢ universally closed. Its local finite type comes from base change and its separatedness from the preceding step; isProper_iff proves properness. The index bound is transitivity, and unfolding Over.pullback identifies its map with the original pullback.map.
